strings.app.name: FarmPhantom
strings.overview.intro: Load your games, add them to the queue, and start idling.
strings.overview.noRunningGames: No games are running. Create and start a queue from the Games page.
strings.games.sessionWarning: Sign in with Steam session cookies only. These cookies grant full access to your account; they stay in memory and are never written to disk. Never share them.
strings.games.cookieHelp: To find them: sign in to steamcommunity.com in your browser → press F12 → Application → Cookies → steamcommunity.com, then copy sessionid and steamLoginSecure. Renew them when they expire.
strings.games.emptySummary: Your games will appear here after you load them.
strings.games.search: Search by game name or App ID
strings.games.emptyState: Enter your SteamID64 and API key, then load your games.
strings.queue.title: Game queue
strings.queue.auto: Automatically queue and start games with cards when games are loaded
strings.drops.title: Card tracking
strings.drops.description: While idling, your inventory is checked regularly. New cards from a game being idled are recorded as drops.
strings.drops.timeoutTitle: Move to the next game if no card drops
strings.drops.explanation: Your inventory is read with your session cookies (private inventories are supported). If the game's badge page shows no drops remaining, the queue moves on immediately. If the page cannot be read, the timeout below applies. Steam may take a few minutes to update your inventory.
strings.drops.parallelExplanation: The queue idles this many games in parallel (Steam supports up to 32). Higher values may increase the risk of account restrictions.
strings.drops.noDrops: No cards have dropped yet. Start idling and new drops will appear here.
strings.stats.title: History and statistics
strings.stats.empty: No drops have been recorded yet.
strings.stats.valueUnavailable: No estimated value calculated. Choose a currency on the Market page.
strings.sales.title: Market
strings.sales.description: Get price suggestions for cards, review the drafts, and list only the ones you approve on the Steam Market.
strings.sales.cookieNote: Market actions use the session cookies entered on the Games page.
strings.sales.inventoryNote: Load your public card inventory using your SteamID64.
strings.sales.inventoryEmpty: Steam must make inventory data publicly available.
strings.sales.autoPriceList: Automatically price and list selected cards
strings.sales.priceExplanation: A buy-order price sells immediately to the highest waiting buyer and usually earns less than the lowest listing. Cards are priced and approved in this flow; listings are still submitted only after the final confirmation.
strings.sales.draftsEmpty: Select cards and get prices to create drafts here.
strings.sales.noListingWithoutApproval: Nothing is listed without your approval.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.steamworksHelp: Idling requires steam_api64.dll. Get it from the Steamworks.NET Standalone package on GitHub or the official Steamworks SDK, then place it beside FarmPhantom.exe. Do not copy it from another game's folder.
strings.settings.richPresence: Show FarmPhantom on my Discord profile (Rich Presence)
strings.settings.presenceGame: Show the game name in the status
strings.settings.presenceHelp: Off by default. When enabled, people viewing your profile can also see a button to join your Discord server.
strings.settings.botHelp: Enter your bot token and connect. Use /bagla in your Discord server to register the bot owner.
strings.settings.botNotifications: Send a DM when a card drops, the queue finishes, or an error occurs
strings.settings.botSecurity: Create a bot in the Discord Developer Portal and add it to your server with bot + applications.commands permissions. The token is encrypted with Windows DPAPI for this Windows account. The bot is online while FarmPhantom is open. Run /bagla once to register the bot owner; notifications and remote commands are limited to that account.
strings.settings.trayOnClose: Minimize to the system tray when the window closes (idling continues in the background)
strings.settings.startWithWindows: Start with Windows (opens minimized to the tray)
strings.settings.startupHelp: Steam cookies are never written to disk. When the app starts with Windows, it waits in the tray. Reopen the window and enter your cookies again to load games, start the queue, and track cards.
strings.settings.notifyDrop: Show a Windows notification when a card drops
strings.settings.soundDrop: Play a sound when a card drops
strings.settings.autoRecover: Automatically retry if idling stops unexpectedly (Steam closes or the process crashes)
strings.settings.recoverHelp: Retries are made after 15 seconds, 45 seconds, 2, 5, and 10 minutes, up to 5 times. Steam must remain open.
strings.settings.diagnosticsHelp: Bot connections, Rich Presence, idling, and card drops are written to the log. If something fails, the log can help identify why. Cookies and keys are never logged.
strings.settings.gameLaunchHelp: The game opens normally through the Steam client.
